findings.finding: Same-BU references do not prove ContactIdentity.contactId equals Conversation.contactId or channel/provider resource equals route resource.
findings.resolution_required: Immutable route with composite contact/BU/resource invariants, typed context schemaVersion2 and server-derived recipient; narrow eligibility policy port.

findings.finding: Cutover reader lacks state-specific handling and request/fingerprint/original snapshot preservation.
findings.resolution_required: State-action matrix for PREPARED/SENDING/UNCERTAIN/AMBIGUOUS/accepted/terminal/unknown; no rewrite of requestFingerprint or originalConversation.updatedAt and no provider calls during v1 recovery.

findings.finding: Multiple business WhatsApp numbers per BU contradict legacy account_id=BU singular number and existing Typebot session semantics.
findings.resolution_required: One durable WhatsApp business resource per BU, official+Evolution over same proven number; multiple Instagram accounts allowed; reject second WA identity by partial unique and conflict before promotion. Multiple WA numbers deferred to separate contract.

findings.finding: Ten-channel truncation, per-channel work and temporal pcv gates remain unspecified.
findings.resolution_required: Batch only relevant routes/connections; explicit pagination and cardinality-derived reply options; seed >10connections and fixed query/time budgets.

positions.correctness: favorable after route and cutover fixes
positions.elegance: focused concepts; one WhatsApp resource avoids unsupported primary routing
positions.structural_soundness: preserve provider dedup namespace and durable identities
positions.operational_fit: DM-first human reply; real proof and WhatsApp regression remain required
